title: The AfroBOAT Party 2027 – Black & Sparkle Edition
venue: Tereza Joanne Boat, King George V Dock
description:
The AfroBOAT Party returns for Bank Holiday Sunday, 29th August 2027 — and this year we’re going BLACK & SPARKLE!

Join us aboard the Tereza Joanne Boat for an unforgettable Bank Holiday Sunday of great music, good people and non-stop party vibes on the water.

DJs playing Afrobeats, Amapiano, R&B, Hip Hop, Bashment & more
BBQ available
Dress Code: BLACK and/or SPARKLE
5PM – 3AM

Tereza Joanne Boat
King George V Dock, London, E16 2JU

SUPER EARLY BIRD TICKETS – ONLY £15

These are limited, so grab yours early and save!
